title: 2020年9月大学英语四级真题（第2套）
paperTitle: 2020年9月大学英语四级真题（第2套）
prompt: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay on the use of PowerPoint （PPT) in class. You can start your essay with the sentence “The use of PowerPoint is becoming increasingly popular in class.” You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
reference: The use of PowerPoint is becoming increasingly popular in class. Walk into almost any lecture hall today, and you will find teachers clicking through colorful slides instead of writing on the blackboard. This shift has clearly changed the way knowledge is delivered. On the one hand, PowerPoint brings obvious benefits. Vivid pictures, charts and animations make abstract points easier to grasp, and teachers save the time once spent on writing, so more content can be covered in one lesson. However, the tool also has its drawbacks. Some teachers simply read the slides word by word, turning a lively lecture into dull reading, while fast-changing pages leave students little time to think or ask questions. In my view, PowerPoint itself is neither good nor bad; what matters is how we use it. Teachers should treat slides as a helpful aid rather than a script, and keep real interaction with students. Only in this way can technology truly serve learning.
keyPoints: 首句原样开篇＋描现象。第一句 'The use of PowerPoint is becoming increasingly popular in class.' 逐字照抄题给首句，落实了'照抄首句开篇'句架；随后 'Walk into almost any lecture hall today, and you will find...' 用可视画面把'越来越普及'具象化，'This shift has clearly changed...' 埋下'这转变有利有弊'的伏笔，完成引出现象＋亮态度的功能。

两面分点各配例。'On the one hand, PowerPoint brings obvious benefits' 领起优点 面，'Vivid pictures... so more content can be covered' 给出直观与省时两个理由；'However, the tool also has its drawbacks' 干净转折，'Some teachers simply read the slides word by word, turning a lively lecture into dull reading' 用具体做法＋后果举证问题面，兑现'两面分点各给例'。

表态＋建议收束。'PowerPoint itself is neither good nor bad; what matters is how we use it' 重申工具中性的中心立场，'Teachers should treat slides as a helpful aid rather than a script' 给出可操作建议，末句倒装 'Only in this way can technology truly serve learning' 有力收尾，落实'回 扣中心提建议'。
